promise.title:
Five minutes,
one idea worth keeping.
promise.body: Every seed is one complete idea with its sources named. You read it, you answer, and next week you still remember it.
promise.signIn: Already have an account? Sign in

interests.title: What are you curious about?
interests.subtitle: Pick at least two. You can change them any time from You.

pace.title: How much time do you have a day?
pace.subtitle: This sets your daily goal. It isn't strict.
pace.timeQuestion: When do you usually have time?

firstSeed.offline: This seed ships with the app — it works without a connection.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the email you created your account with.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Everything you have done so far carries over — you don't start again.
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.unavailable: We can't create an account or sign in right now. Carry on as a guest — everything you read stays on this device.
auth.existingAccountTitle: This email already has an account
auth.existingAccountBody: Sign in to it. What you have read on this device is added to it, and nothing is lost.
auth.carryOver: What you have read on this device is added to your account.
auth.reconnected: We are back online. You can sign in or create an account now.

profile.title: You
profile.guestData: Your data stays on this device
profile.upgradeBody: So your progress follows you to your other devices
profile.localOnly: Without an account, this device only

explore.title: Explore
explore.subtitle: Find a new topic and start there.

player.notFound: That seed could not be found
player.notFoundBody: It may have been removed from the catalogue. Every other seed still works.
player.seeSource: See the source for this answer

image.altRecorded: Alt text is recorded for this image

ordering.hint: Move rows with the up and down buttons

matchPairs.hint: Tap a concept, then tap its description

reflection.note: Writing this is optional and never scored. It is saved for you alone.

summary.title: Three things that stay
summary.note: You'll be asked these three in the day-three review

unknown.title: This part needs a newer version of the app
unknown.body: This seed has a new kind of block that this version doesn't know. You can skip it and carry on — your progress is saved.

sources.title: Sources
sources.empty: No sources are recorded for this seed yet.
sources.report: Report a problem in this seed

report.title: What's wrong with it?
report.note: Reports are read by the editors. Serious ones are looked at the same day.
report.sentBody: Thank you. An editor will read it and fix the seed if needed.

notify.title: Shall we remind you tomorrow?
notify.body: One reminder at a time you choose — at most once a day. Turn it off whenever you like.

account.title: Shall we keep your progress?
account.body: Everything you've read so far is stored on this device. With an account it follows you to your phone and tablet.

points.carriesOver: This same data moves over — you don't start again
points.deletable: You can delete the account at any time

offline.title: You're offline
offline.neverSynced: Nothing has synced yet — seeds on this device still work
offline.assetTitle: This part has an image that isn't downloaded
offline.assetBody: The blocks after this one are text and ready. The image arrives when you're back online — until then you can skip it and carry on.
offline.resumePoint: Your place is saved at block {{block}}

download.corruptBody: The checksum didn't match. Downloading again fixes it.

storage.title: Storage
storage.barA11y: Storage used, {{percent}} percent of the cap
storage.bundledNote: The seed bundled with the app always stays and is never cleared.

error.title: Couldn't connect
error.body: We couldn't fetch today's suggestions. The seeds you've saved are available right now.

fatal.title: Something went wrong that we couldn't fix
fatal.body: This error was logged for our team. If it happens again, please report it with the code below.

reason.explore: A little outside your usual topics

search.hint: Type a topic, or part of a seed's title.
search.emptyTitle: We have no seeds for that
search.emptyBody: We haven't covered this yet. These are the closest things we have.
search.suggestBody: We read every request and weigh it in the content plan.

review.title: Watering
review.intro: About {{minutes}} minutes. Active recall works better than re-reading, so this time you retrieve it yourself.
review.deferNote: If today is busy, “I'll review later” loses nothing — it just moves the queue back.
review.recallHint: Answer it in your head, then reveal. No typing needed.
review.covered: The answer stays covered until you've tried to recall it
review.confidenceNote: Recorded separately from right/wrong, and it sets the next interval.
review.resultsBody: {{count}} seeds reviewed. Each one's next interval is below.
review.emptyBody: Every review for today is done. There's nothing you need to do.

garden.title: My garden
garden.graceDay: You have one grace day; missing a day doesn't spoil the week.

inProgress.title: No half-finished seeds
inProgress.body: Anything you start and don't finish waits here for you.

saved.title: Nothing saved yet
saved.body: Use the bookmark at the top of a seed to keep it for later.

downloaded.title: Nothing downloaded
downloaded.body: Download seeds to open them without a connection.

due.title: Every review for today is done
due.body: There's nothing you need to do today.

completed.title: No finished seeds yet
completed.body: Start your first one from Home; five minutes is enough.

notifySettings.title: Reminders
notifySettings.cap: At most once a day, at a time you choose.
notifySettings.deniedTitle: Notifications are off in your device settings
notifySettings.deniedBody: The app can't change this itself. If you want a reminder, allow it in your device settings — everything else works without it.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.body: This cannot be undone. You can take a copy of your data first.
deleteAccount.exportBody: Your progress and notes come out as a text file.
deleteAccount.startCta: I want to delete my account
deleteAccount.confirmTitle: Sure? There's no way back from this.
deleteAccount.confirmCta: Yes, delete the account and data
deleteAccount.failedRecentLogin: Deleting an account needs a recent sign-in. Sign out, sign back in, and try again.
deleteAccount.failedNetwork: We could not reach the server. Nothing was deleted — try again.
deleteAccount.failedPartial: The deletion did not finish, and nothing on your device was erased. Try again; it resumes where it stopped.
deleteAccount.failedUnknown: The deletion did not run. No data was erased.
deleteAccount.done: Your account and data are gone. You are continuing as a new guest.

authError.weakPassword: A password needs at least six characters.
authError.emailInUse: An account already uses this email. Sign in to get back to it.
authError.invalidCredential: That email or password isn't right.
authError.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
authError.network: We can't reach the network. The seeds on this device still work.
authError.notConfigured: Signing in is not available in this build. Carry on as a guest — everything you read stays on this device.
authError.notAllowed: That sign-in method isn't available right now.
authError.requiresRecentLogin: Sign in again to do that.
authError.unknown: Something didn't go through. Try again.

reminder.title: Today's seed is ready
reminder.body: Five minutes, one idea worth keeping.

maintenance.title: Back shortly
maintenance.body: The service is briefly unavailable. Seeds you have downloaded still open on this device.

updateRequired.title: This version is no longer supported
updateRequired.body: Install the newer version to carry on. Nothing you have read is lost.
